text: Program Description The major of international economy and trade trains students to systematically master the basic principles of economics and the basic theories of international economy and international trade, and master the basic knowledge and skills of international trade. Contemporary understanding of China's foreign trade and international economic and trade development present situation, familiar with common international trade practice and the WTO rules, and China's foreign trade policy laws and regulations, understand the status of the foreign trade of main countries and regions, in the foreign economic and trade sector, foreign companies and government institutions and research institutes engaged in international economy and trade business, management, research and teaching and research work, the applied senior specialized talents. Duration 4 years
